Anza announced on October 21, 2026 at 13:54 UTC that the network's new consensus protocol had taken over, retiring TowerBFT, the voting system Solana has run since its 2020 launch. No outages were reported.

Those votes are aggregated into certificates that can establish consensus in just one or two rounds, substantially reducing the time required to finalize transactions.

## Finality Improvements

Finality was reduced from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds. Votor changes how validators agree on blocks, and it removes the vote transactions that made up most of Solana's on-chain traffic.

## Significance

Anza CEO Brennan Watt called it "the largest, most ambitious blockchain upgrade since 'The Merge'," referring to Ethereum's 2022 switch to proof of stake.
